column3: The Greek explicitly says “in the womb” and uses future “you will call” rather than “you are to give.”

“So honored” supplies the meaning of the Greek question “from where is this to me?”

“With favor” makes an implication of “looked upon” explicit; the Greek also includes “behold.”
